/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('main.go')
tmp = p.with_suffix('.go.tmp')
tmp.write_text('''package main

import (
\\t\"math/rand\"
\\t\"os\"
\\t\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
\\tt := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\\\n\"))

}
''')

PY
cat main.go"

tmp = p.with_suffix('.go.tmp')
tmp.write_text(s)
tmp.replace(p)
PY
gofmt -w main.go"
